First, let's recall the following identity: 

$$
1={csc}^{2}⁡\theta -{cot}^{2}⁡\theta 
$$

Substituting the above identity into the given expression, and then factoring it as a difference of squares, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta }-\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta  & =\frac{{csc}^{2}⁡\theta -{cot}^{2}⁡\theta }{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta }-\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta  \\  & =\frac{(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta )\,\cancel{(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta )}}{\cancel{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta }}-\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta  \\  & =(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta )-\operatorname{cot}⁡\theta  \\  & =\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta .\end{aligned}
$$
